cover: Core Web Vitals in plain words

slides.title: LCP: how fast the page appears
slides.body: Time until the biggest thing in view shows up. Good is 2.5 seconds or less.

slides.title: INP: how fast the page responds
slides.body: Delay between a tap or click and a visible reaction. Good is 200 milliseconds or less.

slides.title: CLS: how much the page jumps
slides.body: How far content moves after it first appears. Good is 0.1 or less.

slides.title: Measured on real visits, not yours
slides.body: Google uses real Chrome visits at the 75th percentile. Your laptop on office wifi is the best case.

slides.title: Scores help, relevance wins
slides.body: Google says good scores don't guarantee a top ranking. Speed matters most once visitors arrive.

slides.title: Sites slow down over time
slides.body: Widgets, tracking tags and camera-sized photos pile up. Track the scores so the slide gets caught early.
